mechanism_claims.claim_text: The current paper supports WAP-8294A as a cyclic lipodepsipeptide family assembled by an NRPS biosynthetic gene cluster in Lysobacter enzymogenes OH11; this is biosynthetic context, not a direct antibacterial mode-of-action assay.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: WAP-8294A family from L. enzymogenes OH11

source_locator.evidence_summary: Introduction describes the 12-residue cyclic lipodepsipeptide scaffold and NRPS biosynthetic cluster.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Does not establish direct cellular target or killing mechanism in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The WAP deletion mutant lacks the Bacillus subtilis inhibition-zone phenotype observed for OH11 broth, supporting that the assay signal is mainly associated with WAP-8294A production.

source_locator.evidence_summary: Figure 2A and Results compare OH11 and OH11-△WAP inhibition zones.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic control only; no direct molecular target assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The current paper cites prior WAP-8294A2 mode-of-action work but does not perform a direct menaquinone, membrane, translation, or protein-synthesis mechanism experiment itself.

source_locator.evidence_summary: References include prior WAP-8294A2 mode-of-action literature; current Results focus on production optimization.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote cited-background mechanism to current-paper direct_mechanism.
